name: Submit a self-service loan application
description:
Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Apply for Loan'. Select the given purpose from the dropdown (exact option text) and enter the given amount. Submit the application. Read back the application reference shown on the confirmation screen.

Returns: application_ref — The loan application reference shown after submission.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, validation_rejected.
